notes: Idea: Texas Electricity Facts Label checker. Bills each month of a Smart Meter Texas CSV or monthly kWh on each plan's EFL terms (base, marginal tiers, TDU, inclusive credit bands, minimum-usage fees, time-of-use windows from 15-minute data), reads pasted EFL text, and recomputes each label's 500/1,000/2,000 kWh averages from the parsed terms so a misread shows as a mismatch; also infers a credit from the three prices alone (line through 500 and 2,000). Real-data check: 200 NREL ResStock AMY2018 homes (simulated, oedi-data-lake reachable) in Harris, Fort Bend, Dallas, Tarrant, Collin: invented credit plan with the lowest 1,000 kWh price cheapest for 54, dearest for 138; median 4.5 of 12 credit months; median night share 30.8%.
